q: How much wood does an economiser on a thermic fluid heater save?
title: Economiser on a wood thermic fluid heater
short: BEE's Solapur report says 30 t of wood a year, about a fifth of a dyeing unit's 144 t, by cooling heater flue gas from 360 C to 120 C to make process hot water. Cost Rs 1.29 lakh, payback 1.7 years at Rs 2,500 a tonne (2010). Size it to your hot water use first.
audience: Yarn dyeing and towel units in Solapur running wood-fired thermic fluid heaters for hot water

ul: Thermic fluid heater of 3 lakh kcal an hour, fired on wood of about 3,200 kcal a kg, 8 hours a day, 240 days a year.
Efficiency 35 to 45%. Flue gas leaves at 330 to 360 C and carries 33 to 38% of the heat.
The unit burns 144 t of wood a year for 288 t of product.
Proposed: a shell and tube economiser in the flue, rated 2,500 litres a day, heating process water to 55 to 60 C, with flue gas leaving at about 120 C.

sections.h: Check the 30 tonnes against your water
p: Heating 2,500 litres a day from 27 C to 55 C takes about 70,000 kcal. At the heater's 35 to 45% efficiency that replaces about 49 to 63 kg of wood a day, roughly 12 to 15 t a year. The report's 30 t needs about 5,000 to 6,400 litres of hot water a day from the economiser. If you use only 2,500 litres, expect the smaller saving and a payback nearer 4 years.

ul: Rs 1.25 lakh for the economiser, insulation, piping and tank; Rs 1.29 lakh in all.
About 2 days to fit; it can be done on a weekly holiday.
Saving in the report: 30 t x Rs 2,500 = Rs 0.75 lakh a year.

example.title: What it does to your carbon figures
lines: Fossil CO2: no change; the saving is wood
Wood saved: 30 t x 3,200 kcal/kg x 4.1868 = about 402 GJ
Biogenic CO2 avoided: 402 GJ x 112 kg = about 45 t
The report's 42 t used 1.4 t CO2 a tonne of wood
Wood per kg of product: 0.50 kg falls to about 0.40 kg
example.note: Wood CO2 uses the IPCC 2006 default of 112 kg CO2 a GJ with the report's calorific value. It is biogenic and reported separately, outside Scopes 1 to 3.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills into records with CO2. It has no factor for wood, so keep wood tonnes from purchase bills as a separate biogenic line; the green loan check shows what a lender asks for on heat recovery.
